item.title: Former PEARL JAM Drummer DAVE ABBRUZZESE Breaks Silence on Rumored Comeback After MATT CAMERON Exit
item.description: Matt Cameron recently stepped away from his role as drummer for Pearl Jam, ending a nearly 30-year run. He didn’t explain why, and the band hasn’t named a replacement, leaving fans and the music press to fill in the blanks.

item.title: After Decades of Defining PEARL JAM’s Sound, Drummer MATT CAMERON Steps Down Without Warning: 'I Am Forever Grateful To The Crew'
item.description: Pearl Jam has confirmed that drummer Matt Cameron is leaving the band after nearly three decades behind the kit. The news came through coordinated statements from both Cameron and the band on social media, catching many longtime fans off guard.
